adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `group.users.delete(user_id)` at line 73 in admin/groups_controller.rb where `user_id` is an integer from `params.require(:user_id).to_i`. The ActiveRecord `has_many` association's `delete` method expects model instances or an array of model instances, not integer IDs. Passing an integer ID will not work as expected - it won't find and delete the user from the association. The correct approach would be to find the user first or use `group.users.where(id: user_id).delete_all` or similar.
